pages.heading: Before the portal
pages.body: Build a vertical Glowstone portal frame in the familiar Nether-portal shape, with a two-block-wide, three-block-tall opening. Activate the opening with water rather than fire. Bring food, building blocks and fall protection. Plan a

pages.heading: Before the portal (cont.)
pages.body: safe return before exploring. Cold Sweat makes this destination generally temperate to cool on KNCraft; carry some warmth, especially while testing unfamiliar heights.

pages.heading: Islands and edges
pages.body: Cliffs and waterfalls from the Aether team's gallery. An island edge may drop

pages.heading: Islands and edges
pages.body: straight into open space. Build crossings with cover and a landing in mind; an uninterrupted view is not a safe path.

pages.heading: Your first landing
pages.body: Mark the portal and make its approach safe. Falling out of the Aether can return you to the Overworld, far from a useful route. Flying enemies and uneven terrain make narrow bridges risky. Gather local materials before a long trip. Skyroot and

pages.heading: Your first landing (cont.)
pages.body: Holystone begin the dimension's equipment progression. Ambrosium supplies useful light and fuel. Keep ordinary survival tasks close to your return point at first.

pages.heading: Local equipment
pages.body: Skyroot tools can give extra drops from appropriate natural blocks. Holystone, Zanite and Gravitite offer further equipment options. Gravitite Ore can float upward; leave room to collect it. An Altar uses Ambrosium to process items and

pages.heading: Local equipment (cont.)
pages.body: repair equipment. The Freezer uses Icestone. Check the relevant JEI processing category: these stations do more than a normal crafting table.

pages.heading: Movement and discovery
pages.body: Moa eggs can be hatched in an Incubator, fueled by Ambrosium Torches. Raise the hatchling before expecting a dependable mount. Keep fall protection even after gaining a new way to travel. The Book of Lore explains local blocks and items

pages.heading: Movement and discovery +...
pages.body: as you discover them. Dungeons have their own progression and defenses; this chapter leaves their solutions and rewards for you to find.

pages.heading: The Glowstone frame
pages.body: Aether portal framing from the owner's capture. Keep the approach clear.

pages.heading: The return path
pages.body: A cloud bridge leads back to the portal. Keep the return route visible.

pages.title: Continue reading
pages.text: Next chapter first; previous chapter below.

pages.heading: Prepare for travel
pages.body: $(l:patchouli:chapters/architecture#portals)KNCraft Architecture$(/l) connects farming, cooking, clothing, tents and portals. Read the new chapter for optional survival recipes, default effects and safe travel. Use /kncraft status to check enabled features.
